programme.desc: The crew helps Walt raise funds at a casino, Alex explores his legal options, Sky travels to Miami to look after her shop, and Ted and Tatiana's relationship hits a roadblock.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Donna teams up with Ceaser's enemy to take him down, the crew bets big to help Walt, and Sky's son Des meets his biological father, despite his mom's initial disapproval.
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew Always Bet on Black Ink

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: The crew throws a going-away party for Mama Bae, Alex moves into Donna's place, Ceaser receives devastating news, and Sky hosts the grand opening of her shop in Miami.
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew Peace Out, America!

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Sky enlists the crew to help with her fashion show in L.A., Miss Kitty and Young Bae talk about their fight, Alex surprises Donna, and Tatiana reaches her breaking point.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Ceaser reunites with an enemy, Krystal has a much-needed talk with her father, and Sky's twerk fashion show includes a surprise that sends Ceaser over the edge.
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew Runner Up For Mother Teresa Number 2

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Free jackets get in the way of Ceaser squashing his beef with Alex, Tokie refuses to accept peace between Tati and Krystal, and Sky plows ahead with Operation Mend Fences.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: With his first solo music performance approaching, Phor decides to put it all on the line and pursue a relationship with Kat. After a harsh meeting with his lawyer, Van's future at 9 Mag is in jeopardy. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: After confronting Charmaine at Phor's concert and learning the truth about Charmaine and Don, Ashley makes a shocking decision about their relationship. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: After Ryan's meltdown, Kat and Van confront him about his erratic behavior. When the crew questions Kat's loyalty to the shop after she plans to attend a tattoo convention in New York without her 9Mag family, tensions escalate. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: The rest of the 9Mag crew heads to New York City to lend support to Kat and get in some partying while they're there. Ceaser and the NY crew throw a mixxxy party in their honor, but things get ugly when Charmaine taunts Don. Presented by VH1.
programme.sub-title: You're Not God And You're Not My Daddy

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: What happens in New York, stays in New York...not! Upon their return from the Big Apple, Charmaine reveals a secret about her and Don's relationship. Phor receives some shocking news about his biological father. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Ryan decides to throw a shop appreciation party in true Chicago summer fashion...on a yacht! While Kat takes some time away from the shop to think things through, the rest of the 9Mag crew lets loose. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: After mending fences with Puma, Cease makes him a partner at 113th only to have his decision be questioned during his 40th birthday celebration. Bae struggles to keep her marriage together, while Sky confronts her son Des, about his recent behavior.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Walt brings his new girlfriend by the shop, which causes Donna to catch a flashback. Young Bae and Rob face difficulties in their marriage. Sky is at a crossroads with her relationship with Des.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Kit's mom passes away in D.C and the news rocks the shop. Donna and Walt duke it out over Jessica. Puma hires new girl London and Bae thinks he has a shady, ulterior motive.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Puma hires London to cover for Kitty which disrupts the precarious balance in the shop. Tati has a run in with the law and Donna faces a major financial setback. Puma tries to bring a little kumbaya to 113 but no good deed goes unpunished.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: In an effort to support Miss Kitty, Ceaser and the crew head down to Memphis, Tennessee so she can reconnect with her mother's roots. Krystal confronts Donna about her behavior during the lock-in. And Walt makes a serious go at standup comedy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Barbara has been a hoarder her entire life. The daughter of a dumpster-diver, Barbara's hoarding spiraled out of control after the deaths of her two sons, one to cancer and the other to a gun accident.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Jackie has filled her 4,000 square foot San Francisco hillside home with $1 million of teddy bears. Will she clean up the ocean of bears or lose her house? Richard previously agreed to his family's pleas for an emergency cleanup.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Shanna owns the worst hoard in “Hoarders” history — a house crammed floor to ceiling with bottles filled with human waste.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Ronald is a firefighter who is legally mandated to report hoarded homes. But in this case, the hoarder is his wife, Eileen, and the house is his own.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Paramedics rushing to save a woman's life lose precious time when they're forced to climb over the hoard they find in Norman's house.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Lloyd's home is so filled that he's been forced to live in one of the many trailers on his property.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Not even losing several inches of her intestine to gangrene has stopped Theresa from hoarding and eating expired food.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Lisa is an active chef, a member of various cooking groups, an expert on historical cooking gadgets -- and a compulsive food hoarder.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Tara has been reported to her landlord and needs to clean out now or she'll be homeless. She's an obsessive collector, favoring things like McDonald's Happy Meal toys.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: This family of 14 was the Brady Bunch of the block--until mother Claudie's hoarding tore the family apart and turned them all into the pariahs of the neighborhood.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Every room in Phyllis' house is packed with dolls. Her obsession has manifested itself into a floor-to-ceiling collection of bags stuffed with dolls.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Chickens roam all over Constance's property, where she runs a "fresh egg" operation.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: The small paths in Michelle's house are the only way she can get to her collection of more than 60 birds. Her husband of 30 years has been chased from the home by the animals and the hoarded piles that in some places reach five feet high.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Laura has terminal cancer and is in fragile health, but sleeping or resting is nearly impossible. The only open spot she can lay her head on is two-thirds of the living room couch.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Andrew's home is an eyesore in a neighborhood of million dollar homes. The exterior and interior are completely hoarded, there's no running water, and Andrew has allowed a homeless man to create a makeshift shelter in his front yard.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Jennifer is a young stay at home mom. Both she and her husband Ron, suffer from hoarding and their three kids are growing up with piles of junk, food, and clothing everywhere.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Kevin is the youngest son of a renowned political strategist and a silver-screen star -- both of whom have stars on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. He grew up in a huge mansion living a charmed life.

programme.title: El mensajero
programme.desc: El ganador del Oscar Gary Oldman y Olga Kurylenko protagonizan un thriller de acción sobre una mensajera que pelea contra los secuaces de un jefe criminal sádico para proteger al único testigo capaz de hundirlo.

programme.title: Brusco despertar
programme.desc: Bruce Willis, Sigourney Weaver y Henry Cavill protagonizan este thriller trepidante sobre un hombre que intenta salvar a su familia secuestrada.

programme.title: Venganza
programme.desc: Durante su permiso de libertad provisional, un convicto logra escapar de los guardias y planea su venganza contra aquellos que lo convirtieron en un asesino a sangre fría.

programme.title: Instinto predador
programme.desc: Un cazador (Nicolas Cage) debe luchar por su vida en un barco cuando sus mortíferos animales -entre ellos un raro jaguar blanco- son soltados por un peligroso criminal que quiere matar a todos a bordo.

programme.title: El hombre sin pasado
programme.desc: Un tranquilo cuidador en una casa de empeño, con un pasado violento, se enfrenta a una red de tráfico de drogas y órganos con la esperanza de salvar a una niña que es su única amiga.

programme.title: 13 horas: los soldados secretos de Bengasi
programme.desc: Del director Michael Bay, 13 horas es la historia de un grupo élite de seis exmilitares asignados para proteger a la CIA, que lucharon cuando los terroristas atacaron un complejo diplomático estadounidense el 11 de septiembre de 2012.

programme.title: Tell en español
programme.desc: Un ladrón de poca monta logra robar un millón de dólares y traiciona a sus cómplices. Ahora deberá escapar de policías corruptos, sus antiguos socios, su oficial de libertad condicional e incluso de su esposa, todos decididos a quedarse con el dinero.

programme.title: El gran asalto
programme.desc: En una patrulla, un policía veterano y su compañero quedan atrapados con un pasajero en un enfrentamiento con exmercenarios que roban un banco.

programme.title: Sumergidos
programme.desc: En lo que debería ser una misión de rescate rutinaria, el submarino USS Tiger Shark encuentra a tres sobrevivientes del ataque de un submarino. Pronto, los visitantes parecen desencadenar una serie de sucesos escalofriantes y de otro mundo.

programme.title: Cazador de demonios
programme.desc: Un maldito pistolero (Wesley Snipes) cuyas víctimas regresan de entre los muertos, recluta a un joven guerrero para ayudar en la lucha contra una banda de zombies.

programme.title: La maldición de Hollow Glen
programme.desc: Hace doscientos años, los habitantes de Hollow Glen sacrificaron a un niño deforme en una hoguera, y del humo surgió algo tan malvado y monstruoso que maldijo al pueblo para siempre.

programme.title: Wishmaster: el genio del mal
programme.desc: Cuando un apreciador de joyas recibe una gema antigua, sin saberlo, desata un espíritu inmortal que concede deseos a los humanos a cambio de sus almas.

programme.title: Escondete
programme.desc: Dos parejas jóvenes han elegido un nuevo sitio para su borrachera: un cuartel abandonado donde hace 45 años, una niña, con discapacidad mental, fue seducida y violada, estrangulada y luego quemada.

programme.title: La maldición de la llorona
programme.desc: Una joven hereda una mansión, solo para descubrir que está hechizada por brujas y espíritus malignos.

programme.title: Leviatán, terror en la profundidad
programme.desc: En esta película de ciencia ficción, un equipo de exploración de aguas profundas descubre un barco de carga con un secreto mortal.

programme.title: Maggie
programme.desc: Cuando un virus zombie arrasa con la nación, un padre no se detendrá por nada para salvar a su hija infectada en este thriller posapocalíptico protagonizado por Arnold Schwarzenegger y Abigail Breslin.

programme.title: Del crepúsculo al amanecer
programme.desc: En este clásico de Tarantino, los bandidos hermanos Gecko ¡cometen una ola de crímenes! Secuestran a un padre y sus dos hijos, y se esconden en un bar mexicano. Pero se enfrentarán a los clientes del bar y se unirán a sus rehenes para sobrevivir.

programme.sub-title: If I Don't Hit Her, She Doesn't Listen

programme.desc: In Scandinavia, at a prize-awarding ceremony, Peter must rescue a writer being held for speaking out against her repressive government.

programme.desc: Dr. Stephens believes his anti-gravity research will endanger mankind; he destroys the papers and disappears. Brady is summoned to track him down.

programme.desc: French authorities call Peter when a doctor brings in a white rabbit she says materialized out of thin air before her eyes.

programme.desc: The Invisible man is investigating an international drug ring when his identity is stolen by a beautiful young woman and used to smuggle drugs.

programme.sub-title: A Strange Hanging - Chantal Ternik Case

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Stabed In Her Bed: The Maureen Jaquier Case

programme.sub-title: Only DNA Can Say - Angélique Dumetz

programme.title: South Park: Die Hippie, Die
programme.desc: Die Hippie, Die: Cartman runs a 'pest control' service to rid the town of hippies and is soon arrested, but when a plague of hippies invades South Park the town turn to him and his methods. (S9, E02)

programme.title: South Park: Wing
programme.desc: Wing: The boys become talent agents to make an easy buck. They take on a Chinese lady named Wing and are soon confronted by the Chinese mafia, looking for a slice of the action. Fight! (S9, E03)

programme.title: South Park: Best Friends Forever
programme.desc: Best Friends Forever: Kenny is in a coma. Cartman wants life-support turned off so he can get his PSP. But Kenny's spirit is leading the armies of heaven against the demons of hell! (S9, E04)

programme.title: South Park: The Losing Edge
programme.desc: The Losing Edge: The boys are bored of playing baseball, and concoct a plan to lose the big play-off game. Randy trains hard to become the biggest drunken jackass at each match. (S9, E05)

programme.title: South Park: The Death of Eric Cartman
programme.desc: The Death of Eric Cartman: Everyone decides to ignore Cartman! He is convinced he is dead and must find peace by making amends for his past sins. Will Butters' 'psychic ability' help him? (S9, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Erection Day
programme.desc: Erection Day: Jimmy's noticed that one of his body parts has a mind of his own, so he tries to control his raging hormones in time to perform his comedy routine at the School Talent Show. (S9, E07)

programme.title: South Park: Hotter Than Summer: Marjorine
programme.desc: Marjorine: Cartman is convinced that the girls have a device which can see into the future. The boys come up with a plan to take it. Unfortunately for Butters he's a major part of the plan. (S9, E09)

programme.title: South Park: Follow That Egg
programme.desc: Follow That Egg: In a bid to prevent Mr. Slave from marrying Big Gay Al, Mrs. Garrison forces the children to help him in an experiment to prove that gay marriages are unstable. (S9. E10)

programme.title: The Border
programme.desc: In southern Alberta, an eco-terrorist sabotages a pumping station, and cracks the mainframe of Westech Oil. Gray and Layla travel to Calgary, where they uncover an international corporate espionage scheme.

programme.title: The Border
programme.desc: An American pop star collapses in New York city and her death is linked to a Canadian cancer medication, prescribed in Toronto and shipped across the border. Kessler and LaGarda investigate the Canadian pharmaceutical company responsible.

programme.title: The Border
programme.desc: A supposed interception of guns goes wrong when the accused links a border guard to his disowned Mormon family.

programme.title: The Border
programme.desc: A media frenzy erupts when it’s leaked that 41,000 illegal immigrants, all with deportation orders, have gone missing across Canada. As Minister Fleischer takes the heat, Kessler and his ICS squad swing into action, rounding up illegals.

programme.desc: As Catherine and Keppler begin to investigate the murder of a teen-aged Jane Doe, both agree that the killer, who was meticulous in removing evidence from the body and its surrounding area, is likely a repeat offender.

programme.title: NEW CSI: Crime Scene Investigation
programme.desc: A case involving a man's torched corpse whose bones and tissues had been harvested leads Nick and Keppler into the disturbing world of illegally sold human body parts.

programme.title: NEW CSI: Crime Scene Investigation
programme.desc: Grissom returns from his teaching sabbatical as new member of the team, Michael Keppler desperately tries to keep his dark past hidden from his colleagues.

programme.title: Rookie Blue: The Girlfriend Experience
programme.desc: While investigating the disappearance of a grad-student-turned escort, the officers discover a pattern of missing women. Since Gail fits the physical description of the victims, she is sent on an undercover sting at a high-end hotel

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Out Of Time
programme.desc: After the officers of 15 Division are forced to release a suspected predator, the grim discovery of the body of a missing girl reopens an unsolved case – bringing back Detective Luke Callaghan in from the Homicide Squad to oversee it.

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Cold Comforts
programme.desc: The officers of 15 Division are still reeling in the aftermath of the unexpected death of one of their colleagues. When they discover that a laptop has been stolen containing sensitive information, they set out to tie up several of open cases

programme.title: Rookie Blue: The Rules
programme.desc: Itʼs “back to basics” for 15 Division when Staff Sergeant Frank Best decides itʼs time for his officers to get back on track

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Every Man
programme.desc: A seasonʼs worth of trials and tribulations come to a head during a frenzied night at the station when the distracted rookies improperly search a prisoner

programme.title: Rookie Blue: I Never
programme.desc: When a violent child abductor escapes from an emergency hospital visit, 15 Division goes on the hunt for the criminal -- only to discover that heʼs taken another young victim

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Surprises
programme.desc: After six months working undercover, Andy and Nick’s operation goes sideways when Nick, then Andy go missing. Meanwhile, a random arrest at 15 Division puts Sam Swarek and the other officers in the middle of the investigation-turned-rescue-mission

programme.title: Sea Patrol: Episode 013

programme.title: Operación Condor - La Armadura de Dios 2
programme.desc: Jackie, un talentoso cazador de tesoros, es contratado para recuperar 240 toneladas de oro que un comandante alemán, Hans von Katterling, y su regimiento enterraron en el desierto del Sahara antes del final de la Segunda Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: El transportador 3
programme.desc: Frank Martin es un indiscutible especialista en entregas de alto riesgo. En esta ocasión está obligado bajo amenazas a trasladar dos voluminosas bolsas y una joven ucraniana desde Marsella hasta Odessa

programme.title: Airline Disaster
programme.desc: El Boeing Next Generation 797 es el nuevo estándar aeronáutico en lujo de pasajeros y tecnología de vuelo. Pero su viaje inaugural encuentra rápidamente la turbulencia cuando una banda violenta toma el control del avión.

programme.title: 500 MPH Storm
programme.desc: Cuando un experimento de energía se descontrola, una serie de huracanes masivos azotan América del Norte. Un científico debe poner a su familia a salvo antes de que los huracanes se fusionen.

programme.title: Daredevil
programme.desc: Un hombre cegado por unos residuos tóxicos, que también han potenciado el resto de sus sentidos, lucha contra el crimen como un acrobático superhéroe de las artes marciales.

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Elektra tras recuperarse de las mortales heridas sufridas en "Daredevil", se convierte en la más peligrosa asesina del mundo.

programme.title: Apocalypse Pompeii
programme.desc: Cuando un antiguo comando de Operaciones Especiales visita Pompeya, su esposa y su hija quedan atrapadas en el Monte Vesubio que entra en erupción con una fuerza masiva.

programme.title: El cuento de los cuentos
programme.desc: Basada en la obra "El cuento de los cuentos" del escritor napolitano del siglo XVII, Giambatista Basile. Esta película es una adaptación mágica, trágica y sangrienta de unos cuentos que sirvieron de inspiración para los hermanos Grimm.

programme.title: Daredevil
programme.desc: Un hombre cegado por unos residuos tóxicos, que también han potenciado el resto de sus sentidos, lucha contra el crimen como un acrobático superhéroe de las artes marciales.

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Elektra tras recuperarse de las mortales heridas sufridas en "Daredevil", se convierte en la más peligrosa asesina del mundo.

programme.title: War of the Worlds
programme.desc: En esta nueva versión moderna del clásico horror de ciencia ficción de H.G. Wells, la civilización se arruina cuando una súper raza de extraterrestre invade la Tierra.

programme.title: La Invasión
programme.desc: Algunos residentes de la ciudad tienen que unirse después de una devastadora invasión alienígena. Mientras luchan por sobrevivir, se dan cuenta de que deben ir un paso por delante de sus atacantes.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: La ciencia moderna nos afirma que, en el nivel más simple, el mundo material no es más que energía y que todos estamos conectados de forma física con el mundo que nos rodea.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Ron y Nancy están convencidos de que su nuevo hogar es demasiado bueno para ser verdad: la histórica casa Baltimore se adapta de forma ideal a su presupuesto y además es tan grande como para alojar a su gran familia.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Existen algunos lazos que no pueden romperse, tal como el vínculo que se establece entre una madre y su hija... o el vínculo psíquico entre un asesino y su víctima.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando Clara y su familia se mudan a una pequeña casa en la zona rural de Hinsdale, Nueva York, se dan cuenta de que la paz de la vida en el campo es simplemente una ilusión y la amenaza de muerte es muy real.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: La casa de rancho de Ed y Beth parece el lugar perfecto para criar a su niño pequeño, hasta que descubren que no están solos y una espesa niebla oscura se cierne sobre la casa y crece día a día.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: En la vida, las personas pueden vivir atormentadas por sus propios crímenes. Lo mismo también puede ocurrir en la muerte: espíritus enojados pueden quedar estacionados en el mismo lugar donde perdieron su humanidad.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: ¿Qué tan diferente podría ser nuestra realidad si no pudiéramos sentir y comunicarnos de las formas más convencionales? Para Marie, este es un tema que forma parte de su día a día. Su hija Julie padece una condición mental que la debilita.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Algunas personas creen que los fantasmas son espíritus humanos que deben lidiar con asuntos aún pendientes y que quizás puedan necesitar la ayuda de los vivos, con el fin de encontrar la paz entre los muertos.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Deb y Tony acaban de comenzar su vida juntos. Con su primer hijo en camino, la pareja trabajadora se muda a una pintoresca casa en Atchison, en el estado de Kansas, con muchas esperanzas en el futuro.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: En la isla de Taiwán muchas personas creen que no existen fronteras entre el mundo material y el reino espiritual. Los fantasmas forman parte de la vida cotidiana.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Hay un demonio suelto en una casa de Connecticut, y un niño de 12 años se lleva la peor parte de su ira. Él ve a un anciano con pezuñas y cuernos, lo golpean y lo arrojan y finalmente es poseído. Solo un exorcismo salvará su alma.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Se ha dicho que cada fotografía roba una parte del alma de un hombre. Entonces, ¿qué ocurre con todas esas partes cuando la persona ya ha fallecido?

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Los niños a menudo se encuentran a merced del mundo de los adultos y, algunas veces, se sienten incapaces de influir en el curso de sus propias existencias.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: En la inocencia de la infancia, el miedo es perfecto, y no resulta influenciado por la racionalidad adulta, lo cual supone que se puede comprender a cabalidad el mundo que nos rodea.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Algunas personas creen que todo nuestro conocimiento del mundo nos llega a través de la percepción sensorial y los poderes del razonamiento. Otras, en cambio, piensan que podemos obtener conocimiento por medio de la intuición.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: La dinámica de las personas que viven bajo un mismo techo puede tener un equilibrio delicado. Mike y su novia, Lisa, mantienen una relación sana y, sin nada que les preocupe, se mudan juntos, pero no están solos en su nueva casa.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Ciertos mitos nativos norteamericanos hablan de criaturas sobrenaturales que protegen a los muertos. Los primeros exploradores de algunas tribus algonquinas del noreste de los Estados Unidos contaban historias sobre hombres lobo.

programme.title: El Investigador Capulina
programme.desc: Capulina confunde al vicepresidente de una empresa con un ladrón. Sus amigos los luchadores Tinieblas y Superzan acuden en su ayuda y evitan un asalto. Capulina creyéndose el héroe decide poner una agencia de investigadores.

programme.title: El Karateca Azteca
programme.desc: Capulina ayuda a un arqueólogo alemán y a su guapa hija, Nadia a visitar ruinas arqueológicas. Una banda de contrabandistas de piezas arqueológicas atrapa al padre de Nadia. Capulina combate a los malhechores con sus artes marciales.

programme.title: El Metiche
programme.desc: Capulina es un metiche que causa peores problemas a la gente que los que ellos tienen antes de que Capulina trata de ayudarlos.

programme.title: El Rey de Monterrey
programme.desc: Capulina y su novia, la sirvienta en una casa rica, deciden dar un paseo usando el automóvil de los patrones. Una banda de roba coches les roban el auto. Capulina y su novia tienen que recuperar el auto antes de que sus patrones se enteren.

programme.title: El Sargento Capulina
programme.desc: Capulina quiere convertirse en superhéroe para combatir el crimen. Se enlista en la policía y después de un riguroso entrenamiento llega a ser sargento y confronta a los criminales en una serie de incidentes cómicos.

programme.title: El bueno para nada
programme.desc: Todos tachaban de torpe al pobre Capulina, ah, pero bien que lo buscan para desactivar la máquina que hizo un científico para destruir el mundo.

programme.title: El circo de Capulina
programme.desc: Capulina viaja a Monterrey para trabajar en un circo y ayudar a su sobrina a recuperar un terreno que ha heredado, el cual esconde un tesoro enterrado por un coronel revolucionario.

programme.title: El médico módico
programme.desc: El mecánico de las ambulancias de un hospital habla de su oficio en términos médicos. En el hospital atiende a un delincuente pero éste sale huyendo provocando confusión y un relajo en todo el hospital.

programme.title: La cigüeña distraída
programme.desc: Un empresario rico y un ranchero humilde confunden a sus gemelos recién nacidos al ir por ellos al hospital y se genera una gran confusión.

programme.title: Los Desenfrenados
programme.desc: Viruta y Capulina son dos camioneros y conocen a unas hermosas fugitivas que huyen de un internado femenino.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman llega a los mejores lugares de las listas de éxitos con su propia banda cristiana de rock, y los chicos son arrestados por bajar música de internet.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Después de que algunos ciudadanos adultos de South Park acribillan algunos mercados de granjeros, los chicos deciden tomar acción contra la generación más vieja.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cuando Kyle elige invitar a Butters en lugar de Cartman en un viaje de cumpleaños, Cartman convenientemente "desaparece" a Butters.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cuando un chico mormón se muda a South Park, Stan tiene que patear su trasero, mientras el resto de los ciudadanos están fascinados y se convierten en mormones.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos van a un restaurante famoso por sus deliciosas alitas y por tener meseras bellas. Butters piensa que ha encontrado a la chica de sus sueños.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La familia Broflovski celebra Hanukkah juntos cuando una pareja canadiense, que se presentan como Harry y Gints Elise, van a su casa.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Después de comprar armas de artes marciales del lejano oriente en un mercado de pulgas local, los chicos se transforman en ninjas.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se disfraza de robot y le hace creer a Butters que es enviado desde Japón. Pero su broma se termina cuando descubre que Butters tiene un vídeo de él disfrazado de Britney Spears que quiere mostrar en la escuela.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Jimmy y Timmy entrenan para participar en las Olimpiadas Especiales y Jimmy acepta esteroides que le ofrece Nathan. Mientras, Cartman se disfraza para convencer a un comité calificado de que él es discapacitado y así ganar el premio.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman convence a Kyle de que vea "La Pasión", la nueva película de Mel Gibson que según Cartman demuestra por qué todo el mundo odia a los judíos. Kyle la mira y tiene una especie de revelación que lo lleva a disculparse con Cartman.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos son desafiados por un grupo de jóvenes bailarines de breakdance, y Stan decide armar un grupo de baile para ganarles.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Humanos del año 3045 están llegando a South Park a través de un portal del tiempo y buscan trabajo. Cuando los chicos tratan de ganar dinero extra, los inmigrantes del tiempo les quitan trabajo a todos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una nueva familia se muda a South Park, el señor Jefferson y su hijo, Blanket. Mientras los chicos se sienten atraídos por la casa llena de juegos, a la policía no le gusta que un negro sea rico, y quieren incriminarlo en un crimen.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos juegan a ser detectives y realizan un buen trabajo resolvendo pequeños misterios locales. Tanto así que la policía los llama para felicitarlos y darles casos verdaderos y peligrosos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Obligados a salir de su tierra por los propietarios del "Casino Indio Tres Plumas", los chicos organizan a South Park para pelear contra los ricos y poderosos Indios.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una nueva familia se muda a South Park, el señor Jefferson y su hijo, Blanket. Mientras los chicos se sienten atraídos por la casa llena de juegos, a la policía no le gusta que un negro sea rico, y quieren incriminarlo en un crimen.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Un Wall-Mart gigante llega a South Park y atrae a los habitantes por sus increíbles ofertas. Cartman queda poseído por sus bajos precios. Stan y Kyle buscan la manera de acabar con eso.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Paris Hilton visita South Park para inaugurar su tienda y, al ver que ella es el ejemplo para miles de niñas, Wendy se preocupa mucho. Por otro lado, el perro de Paris se suicida, y quiere reemplazarlo llevándose a Butters.

programme.desc: Los chicos encuentran un antiguo objeto triangular en una excavación escolar. Luego de salir en el noticiero, Barbra Streisand aparece buscándolo ya que es lo que necesita para poder convertirse en un monstruo gigante japonés.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle está muy enfermo y su madre trata de curarlo con medicinas naturales de una curandera y sus colaboradores "nativos americanos”. Mientras, el señor Garrison es despedido y se convierte en un escritor de novelas románticas.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy propone un plan para arreglar la situación económica mundial. Mientras tanto, Stan intenta devolver una máquina para hacer margaritas, y un salvador inesperado hace el último sacrificio para resolver los problemas de todos.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La última de las pruebas científicas revela que algunos de los chicos de South Park tiene un problema de adicción al sexo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle firma un contrato con la empresa Apple sin leerlo previamente. Mientras tanto, Cartman enloquece a su mamá porque ésta no le compro un iPad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El primo de Kyle, también llamado Kyle, llega de visita desde Connecticut, ya que su madre está enferma. A pesar de ser de la misma edad, los primos no tienen nada en común.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan y Kyle han sido capturados por el Pentágono para que le digan al gobierno exactamente cómo entraron a "Imaginaciónlandia". Mientras tanto, Cartman no se da por vencido en su apuesta con Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El show de Cartman es tendencia, mientras que el país se prepara para vivir la fiesta mas espectacular jamás vista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle quiere jugar a los videojuegos con su hermano menor. Pero cuando Ike no quiere jugar más con él, Kyle teme que la próxima generación lo haya superado.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Sr. Mackey es despedido de la escuela por perder una hoja de marihuana durante una presentación en contra de las drogas. Entretanto, los chicos tratan de salvar a Ike de su fiesta ''bris'' en donde le harán la circuncisión.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman ha logrado “la paz mundial” gracias a una de sus bromas para humillar a Kyle. Este acontecimiento reúne a miles de líderes religiosos de todo el mundo en South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los japoneses están realizando ataques con el fin de aniquilar a todos los delfines y ballenas del planeta. Ante esta situación, Stan decide toma medidas para detener la matanza.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle se enoja con sus padres por no dejarlo ir al concierto de los Raging Pussies, y Cartman le recomienda que le diga a la policía que sus padres lo masturbaron para que los arresten.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una apuesta iniciada porque Cartman vio a un duende es el inicio de un problema, aunado a que los chicos se encuentran frente a la totalidad imaginativa del mundo atacada por un grupo terrorista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se considera el crítico número uno en Internet de restaurantes en South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos intentan cruzar al elefante de Kyle con ''Fofa'', la cerda de Cartman, para un experimento genético de la escuela con el cual intentan ganarle a Terrance. Mientras, Stan lucha contra los abusos físicos de su hermana, Shelly.
programme.sub-title: Un elefante hace el amor con una cerda

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman consigue ganar dinero subiendo videos de unos bebés peleando por una pelotita de crack. Kyle piensa que eso es malo hasta que Cartman lo convence de que no es así.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman le insiste a sus amigos que los ataques terroristas del 11 de Septiembre fueron una conspiración y se dispone a desenmascarar la verdad. Por su parte, el Sr. Mackey quiere saber quién defecó en el baño.

programme.desc: Tres policías (Richard Gere, Ethan Hawke y Don Cheadle), con carreras muy diferentes entre sí, coincidirán durante una redada en la zona más peligrosa de Brooklyn. Del director de la saga Equalizer y guionista de Training Day, Antoine Fuqua.

programme.desc: Un reclutador corporativo, quien también se dedica a robar arte, planea robar una pintura valiosa del candidato perfecto para un trabajo vacante.

programme.desc: Un músico conoce a una mujer con una vida muy distinta y ambos se enamoran.

programme.title: Mi pie izquierdo
programme.desc: Ganadora de Oscars (1989): Mejor Actor y Actriz secundaria. Basada en la biografía de Christy Brown. Aquejado de parálisis cerebral, gracias a su tenacidad y al incondicional apoyo de su madre, consiguió su integración en la sociedad.

programme.title: Nunca es tarde para enamorarse
programme.desc: Narra la historia de Harvey (Dustin Hoffman), un hombre aburrido y cansado, que viaja a Londres para asistir a la boda de su hija con un hombre bastante mayor que ella. Allí, Harvey conocerá a una mujer (Emma Thompson) que le cambiará la vida.

programme.title: Irrational Man
programme.desc: Escrita y dirigida por Woody Allen. Un atormentado profesor de Filosofía (Joaquin Phoenix) encuentra las ganas de vivir cuando comete un acto existencial junto a su amiga y alumna (Emma Stone).

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: James Hunt y Niki Lauda, dos pilotos de Fórmula 1 extremadamente hábiles, mantienen entre sí una intensa rivalidad. Sin embargo, es su enemistad lo que les lleva al límite.

programme.title: El tren de las 3:10 de James Mangold
programme.desc: Dan Evans (Christian Bale) es un veterano, que para aliviar sus penurias económicas, decide escoltar al peligroso forajido Ben Wade (Russell Crowe) mientras llega el tren que tiene que enviarlo ante la justicia. Nominada a dos Oscar ® 2008.

programme.title: La caza
programme.desc: Tras un divorcio difícil, Lucas, de cuarenta años, ha conocido a otra mujer, tiene un nuevo trabajo y se dispone a reconstruir la relación con Marcus, su hijo adolescente. Pero algo va mal. Un detalle. Un comentario inocente. Una mentira fortuita.

programme.title: Un asunto real
programme.desc: Osamu y su hijo encuentran a una niña en la calle, aterida de frío. A pesar de sobrevivir con dificultades gracias a pequeños robos, la familia es feliz, hasta que un incidente imprevisto revela un secreto que pone a prueba los lazos que les unen.

programme.title: El jaguar

programme.title: Acosados
programme.desc: Chuck es un veterano de guerra sin empleo. Un día encuentra un billetero perdido y decide ir a buscar a su propietario, quien resulta ser un gángster llamado Eddie.

programme.title: Llamada oculta
programme.desc: Un psicópata utiliza el sistema de seguridad de alta tecnología de una familia para atraparlos en su propia casa.

programme.title: La Casa Roja
programme.desc: Un anciano y su hermana ocultan un terrible secreto a su hija adolescente adoptiva, sobre una granja abandonada escondida, ubicada en lo profundo del bosque.

programme.title: La fugitiva
programme.desc: Frank Johnson se convierte en testigo ocular de un asesinato. Su esposa, la policía y el asesino lo persiguen por San Francisco.

programme.title: El malvado Zaroff
programme.desc: El conde Zaroff es un loco millonario que vive en una isla solitaria y se dedica a cazar a los náufragos como si fueran animales.

programme.title: Un cubo de sangre
programme.desc: Un ayudante de camarero tonto es aclamado como artista por un gato muerto cubierto de yeso que se confunde con una hábil estatuilla. El deseo de más elogios pronto conduce a una serie de obras cada vez más mortales.

programme.title: Ausentes
programme.desc: Julia y Samuel se mudan con los niños a una urbanización en las afueras de la ciudad. Parece un lugar ideal, pero Julia pronto descubrirá que tan idílico paraje esconde algo extraño. Se da cuenta de que la urbanización está completamente desierta.

programme.title: La Senda
programme.desc: En un intento por salvar su matrimonio, Raúl decide pasar las Navidades con su familia en una cabaña aislada en medio de la nieve. Durante la Nochebuena todo parece marchar bien, pero, de repente, la situación da un giro totalmente inesperado.

programme.title: Dictado
programme.desc: Tras quedarse huérfana, Julia es acogida por Daniel y Laura. Daniel percibe en la conducta de la niña un carácter amenazador que le trae a la memoria un pasado terrorífico que había decidido enterrar para siempre.

programme.title: Dark Angel
programme.desc: La relación de Alex y Evan toma un giro diferente a medida que ambos comienzan de nuevo. Kelly da un salto hacia lo desconocido y Christian propone a Chloe, el nuevo jefe de Miranda, con una canción.

programme.title: Dark Angel
programme.desc: Kelly tiene la mejor noche de su vida, mientras que Alex y Rex tienen una de las más difíciles. Evan se sumerge en el mundo publicitario.

programme.title: The Dead Girl ES
programme.desc: El asesinato de una joven reúne las historias de cinco mujeres: Lonely Arden descubre el cuerpo, Leah cree que la víctima puede ser su hermana desaparecida. Melora cree que es su hija, mientras que Ruth hace un descubrimiento aterrador.

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Dylan protege a la Andrómeda de los mercenarios mientras Beka comienza a preguntarse si están luchando por el lado equivocado.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Aflojando el Fatídico Relámpago
programme.desc: Dylan encuentra una estación espacial llena de niños que creen que está allí para traer la paz matando a sus enemigos.

programme.title: Andrómeda: D Menos Cero

programme.title: Mutante X

programme.title: Mutante X

programme.title: Mutante X

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: Shalimar se vuelve más cercana a otro salvaje cuando es "lujuria a primera vista", pero las cosas se complican cuando su nuevo novio intenta encontrar una cura para su condición.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: Un nuevo mutante es secuestrado de su familia, y Mutante X se propone recuperarlo y averiguar cuál es el interés de Eckhart con él.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: Cuando una plaga que solo afecta a los mutantes se desata, Adam y Eckhart aceptan trabajar juntos para encontrar una cura.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: Eckhart busca un mutante que pueda absorber energía, uno con el que Brennan se involucre románticamente.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: Jesse se enamora de un pirata informático, a quien Eckhart quiere "procurar" para corromper los canales de noticias informáticos públicos contra los Nuevos Mutantes ... y en beneficio de la GSA.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: Un niño que está desarrollando nuevas habilidades mutantes ha sido secuestrado y el equipo accede a buscarlo para su madre. Más tarde se enteran de que fue ella quien secuestró a su hijo.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: El equipo se encuentra con algunas personas que intentan ingresar a un laboratorio de Genomex y descubren que son salvajes.
programme.sub-title: El Ascenso de la Estrella Oscura

programme.title: Mutante X

programme.desc: Dresden acepta un caso sin cobrar después de presenciar la muerte de una mujer que le pide ayuda, pero su investigación le lleva a la magia negra y más muerte.

programme.desc: Dresden se enfrenta al Consejo Superior cuando sospechan que él es responsable de matar a una universitaria y a un mafioso con magia negra.

programme.title: Andrómeda

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Dylan se hace cargo de una barcaza turística en un intento de escapar de mercenarios.

programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: The top-notch team of hosts Bob McKeown, Gillian Findlay, Mark Kelley and Habiba Nosheen provides unique and engaging documentaries from Canada and beyond. "The Fifth Estate" is a reference to the term Fourth Estate, and was chosen to highlight the program's determination to go beyond everyday news into original journalism. The series has won numerous awards for its reporting, including Gemini Awards, International Emmys, the Michener Award, and even an Academy Award for a 1981 episode that was released in theaters the following year. Since September 1975, Canadians have tuned in to experience interesting stories that are always well-crafted and thought-provoking.

But orders for the division to pull out of the area place the squad in the uncomfortable position of attempting the rescue at the risk of going against military protocol.

programme.title: Laurent de Wilde
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences. In 2017, French pianist Laurent de Wilde performed his tribute to jazz icon Thelonious Monk at Jazz à Vienne. Alongside bassist Jérôme Regard and drummer Donald Kontomanou, De Wilde gives a respectful and engaging homage built upon 20 years of study.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Tony Coe, Derek Humble & Billy Mitchell
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music. On November 4, 1970 he played a concert in Denmark with the Kenny Clarke/Francy Boland Big Band, performing Con Alma, Brother K, Now Hear My Meanin', Manteca, Let Me Outta Here, and Things Are Here.

programme.title: Jimmy Smith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Carla Bley, Steve Swallow, Wayne Krantz & Victor Lewis
programme.sub-title: Carla Bley Sextet live at Estival Lugano 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Discover the special bond between pianist Carla Bley and bassist Steve Swallow. The two have performed in the same bands since the '60s and have been romantic partners for more than two decades. Watching them perform is the definition of musical telepathy. Together with musicians Wayne Krantz, Victor Lewis, Larry Willis, and Don Alias, they form an amazing sextet at Estival in 1986.

programme.title: Gary Burton & Makoto Ozone
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1995, vibraphonist Gary Burton and pianist Makoto Ozone, both great jazz players noted for their virtuoso technique and innovative style, came together to give a concert of improvised music. They delighted the audience with their fluid, poetic artistry, which was expressed in a performance of the highest order.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery's virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform “Extensions” in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock's avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of “Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: Idris Muhammad, Curtis Fuller, Joe Henderson & Kenny Drew
programme.desc: This assemblage of authentic luminaries recreates the sound of Paris in the 50's and 60's when the City of Light was Europe's mecca for American jazz musicians. The Paris Reunion Band was formed as homage to Kenny Clarke and the spirit of his fellow Paris jazzmen.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Larry Graham
programme.sub-title: Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham & Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers' came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career. It is often said that Graham pioneered the art of slap-pop playing on the electric bass, which has become a staple of modern funk. During this Paris performance, Graham shows he is one of the heroes of funk!

programme.title: Gaming X Symphony
programme.desc: Explore the captivating sounds of epic gaming worlds brought to life by 150 musicians and singers at DR Koncerthuset. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by legendary video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, featuring Nordic vocalist Eivør as a special guest in Legends Never Die and more.

programme.title: Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería & Carlos Miguel Prieto
programme.desc: The Youth Wunderhorn songs are a set of 12 orchestral lieder by Mahler, based on folk poems from the collection by Arnim and Brentano, blending romanticism with folk elements and exploring human experience with authenticity and profound emotional depth. The songs draw from German folk traditions, incorporating themes of nature, love, and soldier life, often with a dramatic or poignant quality.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing a charming work by Mozart, with a sentimental connection to the conductor: Symphony No. 36 'Linz is named after the hometown of Welser-Möst. Mozart wrote the piece when stopping over on a trip from Vienna to Salzburg. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in January 2022.

programme.title: Les Dissonances & David Grimal
programme.sub-title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. The composer wrote the symphony between 1877 and 1878, and dedicated it to Nadezhda von Meck – an exceptionally wealthy widow and great admirer of Tchaikovsky's music, whom the composer described as ‘my best friend'. Tchaikovsky explained in his letters that the symphony is characterization of the nature of fate. The work opens with a powerful motif in the horns and bassoons representing fate. The second movement expresses melancholy, whereas the third presents ‘fleeting images that pass through the imagination when one has begun to drink a little wine'. Although the ‘fate' motif reappears toward the end of the final movement, the movement has a festive character. This performance was recorded at La Cité de la musique in Paris in 2016.

programme.title: Jan Latham-Koenig, Symfonieorkest Vlaanderen & Pascal Amoyel
programme.sub-title: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program opens with Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides). During a trip to Scotland, the composer was deeply impressed by the natural splendor of Staffa, an island of the Inner Hebrides, which inspired him to compose his concert overture. Next on the program is Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16, featuring Pascal Amoyel as the pianist. It is the composer's only concerto. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. The program ends with Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92. The work is very popular, especially because of its touching second movement. At the Allegretto's 1813 premiere, the audience demanded an immediate encore.

programme.title: Elena Bashkirova, Juliane Banse, Emmanuel Pahud & Claudio Bohorquez
programme.desc: The extraordinarily talented pianist Elena Bashkirova has been president of the Felix Mendelssohn-Bartholdy Foundation in Leipzig since October 2020, succeeding legendary conductor Kurt Masur. In this concert at the Mendelssohn House in Leipzig, Bashkirova is joined by soprano Juliane Banse, flutist Emmanuel Pahud, cellist Claudio Bohórquez, clarinettist Karl-Heinz Steffens, and pianist Ohad Ben-Ari in a chamber music program dedicated to the music of Mendelssohn and his sister Fanny Hensel. The program opens with Mendelssohn's Piano Trio in D minor, Op. 49. This is followed by a selection of songs: Mendelssohn's Schilflied ‘Auf dem Teich, dem regungslosen', Op. 71 No. 4, and Reiselied ‘Der Herbstwind rüttelt die Bäume', Op. 34 No. 6 Hensel's Vorwurf, Op. 10 No. 2 Verlust, Op. 9 No. 10 and Sehnsucht, Op. 9 No. 7 Mendelssohn's ‘Allnächtlich im Traume seh ich dich', Op. 86 No. 4 ‘Die Liebende schreibt', Op. 86 No. 3 and Nachtlied ‘Vergangen ist der lichte Tag', Op. 71 No. 6. The program continues with Mendelssohn's Seven Songs without Words, for piano four-hands (Op. 62 Nos. 1-6, and Op. 67 No. 1), and comes to a close with Mendelssohn's Three pieces for clarinet, violoncello and piano (arr. Ernst Naumann), comprising Prelude, Op. 35 No. 4, Songs without Words, Op. 53 No. 2, and Duet, Op. 38 No. 6. This performance was recorded in November 2020.

The only problem is, in the sixteen Earth years since the first humans landed on Rhea, two hundred and eighty-eight years have passed on the new planet and the existing population are no longer welcoming new arrivals, with the Rheans having set up a space blockade to shot down any ship that tries to cross into their territory. 'Earther', Bran, has big dreams of a better life in this new world, but the odds are stacked against him. Finding himself the lone survivor of a failed emigration attempt, his escape pod floats mindlessly in space and his oxygen is running low. His only chance of survival is to hook up to a rogue Rhean supply ship called The Nysa running on auxiliary power. But after finding the crew on board The Nysa dead, it seems Bran may have more than just a hostile planet to worry about. An intense interstellar thriller with an impressive cast, including Stephen Moyer (True Blood), Casper Van Dien (Starship Troopers) and John Rhys-Davies (the Indiana Jones and Lord of the Rings franchises).

With time ticking away, the mismatched dozen are forced to work together to keep the peace and work toward their payday. But, when they have to deal with an untimely death, a kidnapping plot, another corpse, burglars, and then even a visit from the boys in blue, will this hapless clan be able to hold it together or will their dreams of riches be buried with the bodies? Staring Miranda Hart (Miranda, Call the Midwife) and Katy Wix (Not Going Out), this is classic British farce at its best.

Driven by his desire to understand his lost son, Tom decides to embark on the historical pilgrimage, leaving his California life behind. Armed only with his son's backpack and guidebook, he begins the 800km historical pilgrimage but soon discovers that he won't be alone on this journey - he meets other pilgrims from around the world, all broken and looking for greater meaning in their lives. From the hardship experienced along "The Way" an unlikely group of misfits are bonded and Tom begins to learn the difference between 'The life we live and the life we choose.'

programme.title: Laurent de Wilde
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences. In 2017, French pianist Laurent de Wilde performed his tribute to jazz icon Thelonious Monk at Jazz à Vienne. Alongside bassist Jérôme Regard and drummer Donald Kontomanou, De Wilde gives a respectful and engaging homage built upon 20 years of study.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Tony Coe, Derek Humble & Billy Mitchell
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music. On November 4, 1970 he played a concert in Denmark with the Kenny Clarke/Francy Boland Big Band, performing Con Alma, Brother K, Now Hear My Meanin', Manteca, Let Me Outta Here, and Things Are Here.

programme.title: Jimmy Smith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Carla Bley, Steve Swallow, Wayne Krantz & Victor Lewis
programme.sub-title: Carla Bley Sextet live at Estival Lugano 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Discover the special bond between pianist Carla Bley and bassist Steve Swallow. The two have performed in the same bands since the '60s and have been romantic partners for more than two decades. Watching them perform is the definition of musical telepathy. Together with musicians Wayne Krantz, Victor Lewis, Larry Willis, and Don Alias, they form an amazing sextet at Estival in 1986.

programme.title: Gary Burton & Makoto Ozone
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1995, vibraphonist Gary Burton and pianist Makoto Ozone, both great jazz players noted for their virtuoso technique and innovative style, came together to give a concert of improvised music. They delighted the audience with their fluid, poetic artistry, which was expressed in a performance of the highest order.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery's virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform “Extensions” in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock's avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of “Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: Idris Muhammad, Curtis Fuller, Joe Henderson & Kenny Drew
programme.desc: This assemblage of authentic luminaries recreates the sound of Paris in the 50's and 60's when the City of Light was Europe's mecca for American jazz musicians. The Paris Reunion Band was formed as homage to Kenny Clarke and the spirit of his fellow Paris jazzmen.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Larry Graham
programme.sub-title: Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham & Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers' came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career. It is often said that Graham pioneered the art of slap-pop playing on the electric bass, which has become a staple of modern funk. During this Paris performance, Graham shows he is one of the heroes of funk!

programme.title: Gaming X Symphony
programme.desc: Explore the captivating sounds of epic gaming worlds brought to life by 150 musicians and singers at DR Koncerthuset. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by legendary video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, featuring Nordic vocalist Eivør as a special guest in Legends Never Die and more.

programme.title: Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería & Carlos Miguel Prieto
programme.desc: The Youth Wunderhorn songs are a set of 12 orchestral lieder by Mahler, based on folk poems from the collection by Arnim and Brentano, blending romanticism with folk elements and exploring human experience with authenticity and profound emotional depth. The songs draw from German folk traditions, incorporating themes of nature, love, and soldier life, often with a dramatic or poignant quality.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing a charming work by Mozart, with a sentimental connection to the conductor: Symphony No. 36 'Linz is named after the hometown of Welser-Möst. Mozart wrote the piece when stopping over on a trip from Vienna to Salzburg. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in January 2022.

programme.title: Les Dissonances & David Grimal
programme.sub-title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. The composer wrote the symphony between 1877 and 1878, and dedicated it to Nadezhda von Meck – an exceptionally wealthy widow and great admirer of Tchaikovsky's music, whom the composer described as ‘my best friend'. Tchaikovsky explained in his letters that the symphony is characterization of the nature of fate. The work opens with a powerful motif in the horns and bassoons representing fate. The second movement expresses melancholy, whereas the third presents ‘fleeting images that pass through the imagination when one has begun to drink a little wine'. Although the ‘fate' motif reappears toward the end of the final movement, the movement has a festive character. This performance was recorded at La Cité de la musique in Paris in 2016.

programme.title: Jan Latham-Koenig, Symfonieorkest Vlaanderen & Pascal Amoyel
programme.sub-title: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program opens with Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides). During a trip to Scotland, the composer was deeply impressed by the natural splendor of Staffa, an island of the Inner Hebrides, which inspired him to compose his concert overture. Next on the program is Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16, featuring Pascal Amoyel as the pianist. It is the composer's only concerto. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. The program ends with Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92. The work is very popular, especially because of its touching second movement. At the Allegretto's 1813 premiere, the audience demanded an immediate encore.

programme.title: Elena Bashkirova, Juliane Banse, Emmanuel Pahud & Claudio Bohorquez
programme.desc: The extraordinarily talented pianist Elena Bashkirova has been president of the Felix Mendelssohn-Bartholdy Foundation in Leipzig since October 2020, succeeding legendary conductor Kurt Masur. In this concert at the Mendelssohn House in Leipzig, Bashkirova is joined by soprano Juliane Banse, flutist Emmanuel Pahud, cellist Claudio Bohórquez, clarinettist Karl-Heinz Steffens, and pianist Ohad Ben-Ari in a chamber music program dedicated to the music of Mendelssohn and his sister Fanny Hensel. The program opens with Mendelssohn's Piano Trio in D minor, Op. 49. This is followed by a selection of songs: Mendelssohn's Schilflied ‘Auf dem Teich, dem regungslosen', Op. 71 No. 4, and Reiselied ‘Der Herbstwind rüttelt die Bäume', Op. 34 No. 6 Hensel's Vorwurf, Op. 10 No. 2 Verlust, Op. 9 No. 10 and Sehnsucht, Op. 9 No. 7 Mendelssohn's ‘Allnächtlich im Traume seh ich dich', Op. 86 No. 4 ‘Die Liebende schreibt', Op. 86 No. 3 and Nachtlied ‘Vergangen ist der lichte Tag', Op. 71 No. 6. The program continues with Mendelssohn's Seven Songs without Words, for piano four-hands (Op. 62 Nos. 1-6, and Op. 67 No. 1), and comes to a close with Mendelssohn's Three pieces for clarinet, violoncello and piano (arr. Ernst Naumann), comprising Prelude, Op. 35 No. 4, Songs without Words, Op. 53 No. 2, and Duet, Op. 38 No. 6. This performance was recorded in November 2020.

En la actualidad sus blancos filetes siguen siendo exportados a todo el mundo. Aviones de carga de la antigua Unión Soviética llegan diariamente para recoger cargamentos de pesca y, a cambio, descargan armas y munición para las innumerables guerras que tienen lugar en el corazón de África.

Cuando el dúo se las apaña para irrumpir en la iglesia, descubre que alguien ha jugado. Para conseguir el dinero, Durell y LeeJohn se ven obligados a pasar la noche en presencia del Señor y sus seguidores, consiguiendo un botín mucho mayor de lo que esperaban.

Frente a las amenazas de cierre y el descenso de inscripciones, Charlie llama a su padre, de quien está distanciado, para que le ayude a organizar el campamento y a enseñar a todo el mundo a trabajar en equipo con perseverancia y flexibilidad.

A pesar de convertirse en héroe de guerra, Jeb lucha contra enemigos ocultos y un destino trágico en el salvaje Oeste.

Entre amistades, amores y dudas, enfrenta los giros del destino y encuentra el valor de elegir por sí misma. Una historia de identidad, libertad y coraje frente a decisiones que marcan la vida.

programme.title: Una pequeña mentira

La oportunidad se presenta cuando Theó está a punto de ser admitido en un importante club de fútbol inglés, pero debido a su pequeña estatura es finalmente rechazado. Para no darle una mala noticia a su padre, Théo no se atreve a confesárselo, lo que da pie a una pequeña mentira que muy pronto le vendrá muy grande.

programme.title: El club de los incomprendidos

Casa, instituto, amigos…La cosa se complica todavía más cuando Valeria se ve obligada a asistir al grupo de terapia que organiza el psicólogo del instituto. Allí se encontrará con otros compañeros que también se ven obligados a ir pero lo que parece un mal comienzo paralajoven adolescente, no es más que el inicio de una increíble experiencia vital nuevos amigos, una ciudad llena de posibilidades, acariciar la madurez y sobre todo descubrir que el primer amor es bastante más complicado de lo que se dice en loscuentos de princesas.

programme.title: Primavera en Normandía

De su juventud le queda una gran imaginación y su pasión por la literatura, con un profundo aprecio por Gustave Flaubert. La emoción le invade cuando un matrimonio inglés se instala en la casa vecina, no sólo porque sus nombres son Gemma y Charles Bovery, sino porque sus comportamientos parecen replicar los de los personajes de la obra Madame Bovary, que incluye una serie de relaciones románticas y sexuales que se encaminan hacia un final incierto. Pero la hermosa Gemma no ha leído la novela clásica, y tiene la intención de vivir su propia vida, en especial cuando su antiguo novio, Patrick, aparezca de nuevo en su vida.

programme.title: La vida abismal

programme.title: Contrición

Pero de repente, su marido (Anthony Edwards, "ER") jura que nunca tuvieron un hijo y su psiquiatra (Gary Sinise, "C.S.I.: NY") insiste en que sufre delirios. Pero lo peor de todo es no hay ninguna evidencia para probar que Sam haya existido alguna vez. Obsesionada por los recuerdos de su hijo, la búsqueda por la verdad embarca a Telly en una oscura y devastadora conspiración de terror sobrenatural.

Para salvarla, este sacerdote guerrero tendrá que romper su juramento de paz, y darle caza al enjambre antes de que sea demasiado tarde.
